title: Confidential guest wire profile
description: Value of the GUEST_WIRE_PROFILE environment variable: one line of canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace), bytes 0x20-0x7e only, no '$' (the kubelet rewrites it), at most 16 KiB. Each identifier is a list; element 0 is emitted and every element is accepted. Byte-domain values are ASCII prefixes to which readers append their NUL separators; the session and control-bridge schemas derive from the session and controlAuthorization domains (lower case, '_' as '.'). A reader takes legacy defaults for a missing releaseSet or workloadRef only while every identifier emits its legacy value; nebula always renders both.

payloadTypes.description: DSSE payload types of the signed statements, application/vnd.<schema>+json. Within this group a value appears in at most one identifier, emitted or accepted; readers reject a profile that breaks this.

domains.description: Byte domains separating hashed and signed messages. Within this group a value appears in at most one identifier, emitted or accepted; readers reject a profile that breaks this. No two controlAuthorization domains may derive one schema.

releaseSet.description: What a release and a release set carry beyond their fixed fields: exactly one scope field with an accepted value (the first scope entry is what signers write), and member roles, node among them.

workloadRef.description: The workload this Pod's adapter serves, compared exactly: one string, never an accept list.
